latestSermon.title: Faith in Action
latestSermon.description: In this message, we explore how true faith is demonstrated through our actions and how we can live out an authentic faith in our daily lives.

about.welcomeSubtitle: A Place of Worship, Fellowship, and Service
about.mission: The mission of First Haitian Baptist Church of Kissimmee is to glorify God by making disciples of Jesus Christ through biblical teaching, authentic worship, fellowship, and service in our local community and beyond.
about.vision: Our vision is to be a multicultural and dynamic community where every person can grow spiritually, develop meaningful relationships, and engage in transformative ministry, reflecting the love and grace of Jesus Christ.

biblicalFoundation.title: Biblical Foundation
biblicalFoundation.description: We believe in the supreme authority of the Bible as God's Word, an infallible guide for our faith and conduct.

passionateWorship.title: Passionate Worship
passionateWorship.description: We are committed to authentic worship that honors God and builds faith, reflecting the richness of our Haitian heritage.

unitedCommunity.title: United Community
unitedCommunity.description: We cultivate authentic relationships where everyone finds their place, their identity in Christ, and their call to serve.

integralMission.title: Integral Mission
integralMission.description: We respond to Christ's call by serving our local community and supporting missionary work around the world.
